independent_blockers.note: The container gates were blocked by more than one independent cause. This record previously attributed their non-execution solely to container-registry egress policy.

blockers.independent_of: container-registry egress denial; this blocker is separate and neither causes nor is caused by it
blockers.symptom: the container job failed at action resolution in about two seconds, before any step ran: "Unable to resolve action `aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0`, unable to find version `0.28.0`"
blockers.root_cause: the workflow pinned the ref `0.28.0` while the upstream tag is `v0.28.0`. The version existed; the ref did not. Because resolution happens before the first step, the job could never start regardless of container runtime or registry access.
blockers.consequence_while_present: no container gate could execute for any reason, so the egress denial was not the only thing blocking them
blockers.pin_rationale: a full commit SHA is the only immutable action reference; the tag is retained as a trailing comment for readability only
verification_performed: the SHA exists in aquasecurity/trivy-action itself, confirmed against a clone whose origin is https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-action, not a fork
git rev-parse v0.36.0^{commit} resolves to exactly this SHA, and v0.36.0 is the only tag pointing at it
v0.36.0 is the highest version tag in the repository
action.yaml at that exact SHA declares all five inputs the step uses: image-ref, severity, exit-code, format, output
no scan policy, severity threshold, exit-code behaviour or image reference was changed - only the uses: reference
blockers.clearance_rule: this blocker becomes CLEARED_BY_PIN_CHANGE only after a new workflow run successfully resolves and starts the action. The pin change alone does not clear it.
blockers.scope_limit: clearing action resolution establishes only that the action resolves and starts. It does NOT establish that Trivy's executable, its vulnerability databases, or any other runtime dependency are reachable from this environment; a failure of those is a separate blocker to be recorded separately.

gate_execution_state_unchanged: every gate in not_executed remains NOT_EXECUTED; a P3E-CTR gate is marked executed only when its own gate step completes with its required evidence
